title: Write Your Asset Column in 10 Minutes
hook_text: NAME ONE THING THAT PAYS YOU

beats.say: Most people cannot name one thing they own that pays them every month.
beats.visual: Low angle close-up of worn car keys sitting on wet asphalt beside an empty parking bay, illuminated by a harsh sodium light.

beats.say: Your paycheck funds today, but what actually funds your life when you stop working?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone worker walking through a cold fluorescent underpass at night.

beats.say: Most think their house or car is an asset, but if it drains cash, it's a liability.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a dark sedan sitting idle inside an unlit concrete garage beneath a single overhead bulb.

beats.say: So how do you build an asset column that pays you, starting in ten minutes?
beats.visual: Blue hour view of an empty commuter train platform slick with rain, distant signals reflecting on the tracks.

beats.say: Step one. Open a blank note on your phone titled My Asset Column.
beats.visual: Close-up of hands holding a dark smartphone screen in a dimly lit diner booth, fog on the window.

beats.say: List everything you own that deposits cash into your bank each month, even if it's $0.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a minimalist dark wooden desk illuminated by a single practical brass desk lamp.

beats.say: Step two. Add one target line item, like $100 a month into an 8% index fund.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a dark fountain pen resting on a blank black notebook beside a rain-slicked window at night.

beats.say: What does writing down a tiny $100 deposit actually build over time?
beats.visual: Silhouette of high-voltage power lines stretching across a misty twilight horizon.

beats.say: At 8% a year, $100 a month invested for 30 years becomes $149,036 from $36,000 put in.
beats.visual: Low angle looking up at towering brutalist concrete walls cut by sharp, cold fluorescent beam light.

beats.say: Step three. Automate that transfer right now so your asset column grows on its own.
beats.visual: High angle extreme close-up of an unbranded dark metallic key resting on a dark slate counter under cool light.

beats.say: Real talk: passive income takes years of deliberate work, not overnight magic.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary cargo ship moving across dark open water during the blue hour.

beats.say: Once your asset column pays your monthly bills, you don't need a job to survive.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing on a windy mountain ridge line overlooking a distant glowing city skyline at night.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, so you know what pays you.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of wet asphalt reflecting sodium streetlights stretching into an empty highway at night.

caption:
Most people list what they spend, not what pays them. Here is how to fix your asset column today.

#money #personalfinance #wealth #investing #asset column
description: Learn how to build a real asset column in ten minutes. Distinguish between assets and liabilities and set up automated momentum today.
first_comment: How many items on your asset column pay you today?

facts.claim: $100/month invested for 30 years at 8%/yr monthly compounding equals $149,036 on $36,000 principal
An asset puts cash in your pocket; a liability takes cash out
facts.basis: Robert Kiyosaki Framework (Rich Dad Poor Dad)

loop_map.stakes: Most people own liabilities that drain cash rather than assets that pay them.
loop_map.big_question: How do you start an asset column that pays you?
loop_map.assume: Houses and cars are assets that make you secure.
loop_map.reveal: Assets must cash-flow positive; an automated small deposit starts your column today.
